results.title: first step doubles the norm
results.label: lem:xelower
results.summary_en: Lemma 5.15 verified unconditionally in the fixed-delta reading (eta may depend on delta); the uniform-in-delta reading was our encoding choice and was retired (enc1).

results.title: L steps multiply norm by 2^L
results.label: lem:xlower
results.partial: Everything except the gap main theorem is verified: proved steps follow the printed route; auxiliary L02_main_fixedDelta_osc proves the statement with (18) as explicit premise.
results.summary_en: Lemma 5.16: proof cites (18) at TEX:930 which the lemma does not assume (PAPER_ARGUMENT_GAP); conclusion still true under (17), not threatened.

results.title: acceptance rate tends to zero
results.label: lem:arate_0
results.summary_en: Lemma 5.17 verified conditionally on the consumed clause of Lemma 5.16 (L03_L02Consumed); editorial/exposition notes only.

results.title: light tails not geometrically ergodic
results.label: thm:light
results.summary_en: Theorem 5.14 verified conditionally on the L02 consumed clause, Prop 3.5 and Gaussian facts; X1 passage to esssup r=1 is a fair implicit step.

results.title: negative results for HMC
results.label: thm:negative
results.summary_en: Theorem 2.2 verified conditionally: part (i) via Thm 5.14 (T02) and part (ii) via the cited Thm 5.18 (external input), with X3/X2 exposition gaps noted.

results.title: exponential family HMC
results.label: crly:expfam
unencoded: part (i) (1 <= beta <= 2: geometric ergodicity; proof at source/geo_erg_HMC_v3.1.tex:806-853): not encoded, outside the scope set by the user
results.partial: Part (ii): S1,S3,S4,S5 and the assembly via T01_main verified; only S2 ((18) for 2<beta<log2 6) fails. Part (i) not encoded (outside user scope).
results.summary_en: Cor 2.3(ii): the appeal to Thm 2.2 at TEX:806 fails for 2<beta<log2(6) because (18) is false there (PAPER_ARGUMENT_GAP); conclusion not refuted.
